test_results.meaning: The Comfy node submitted successfully, but the image API upstream failed with 502 for two image inputs.

test_results.test: single Tuobaye turnaround sheet as reference
test_results.meaning: Single reference image preserved adult face, rough costume, rope belt, and green bamboo flute well enough for storyboard-stage use.

production_policy: Use one strong character or location reference image per storyboard generation when possible.
For multi-character frames, prefer the primary character turnaround sheet as image reference and lock secondary characters with text until multi-image reference reliability improves.
Do not rely on multi-image reference generation for production until repeated 502 failures are resolved or the image provider/baseURL is changed.
Keep Gemini video generation on a single approved storyboard image as the visual source of truth.
